scope: One bounded read-only business-state observation and new private report/publicHTML capture output. Not Gate, Preview, writer exclusion or full inventory.
reviewed_boundaries: Only stdlib imports; no private app imports, network, subprocess or service changes.
Business files read via nofollow descriptors with metadata pre/post/name checks; directory components nofollow.
SQLite URI mode=ro, query_only, short read transactions, progress deadline; normal reader locking/shared-memory semantics acknowledged.
Explicit sources/dependencies/routing11runtime and2N+4coreHTML; published diagnostic targets plus optional landing pages; newcar media stat only, no inventory traversal.
Output must be NEW direct child of existing private inbox; directory0700, files0600 O_EXCL/NOFOLLOW, no overwrite retry.
180second SIGALRM and160second collection budget; deadline checked before capture save and each capture; after hardexpiry only best-effort partial outcome.
Private source bytes and full DBrows not exported; captured publicHTML +sixpubliccarfields +digests only.
Drift, missingrequiredfiles, symlink, timeout, partialexport remain PARTIAL_NOT_ACCEPTED.

finding_resolved.finding: Hardalarm caught internally could continue64MiB capture write after timer consumed.
finding_resolved.fix: Totaldeadline guard before entering save and eachcapture; outer terminal partial path.

limitations: Endpoint agreement is not global writer exclusion.
Current static hosting mappings and HTTP behavior not established.
Only explicitly named input surface observed; metadata-only media is not full resource content validation.
Terminal final summary/exportmanifest required to reuse capture; an earlier embedded observation summary alone cannot prove completed transfer.
A blocked filesystem syscall and tiny best-effort terminal status persistence cannot provide hard real-time OS guarantees.
